integrity: The proof combines an exact seed subsequence-count table with a general morphism-transfer identity for binomial coefficients. A standalone verifier recomputes the seed signatures, checks iterated factor inheritance and equivalence on finite stress ranges, and independently exhausts the transfer identity on small binary morphisms.
scientific_limitations: The result proves third-order strictness at the explicit infinite lengths 10*2^t. It does not compute the complete third-order binomial complexity, and it makes no fourth-order equality claim.
title: Explicit infinite third-order binomial collisions in the period-doubling word
